title: L3 appeal pattern
description: Spec: CORPUS_DESIGN.md §3.3.3. Exactly one record per reason code (gate G3), keyed by the code itself. The anti_patterns block is not documentation — it is the input to stage 4, the readiness critique (B6, evaluator-optimizer), which is shown free pre-paywall. It is therefore the highest-leverage content in Corpus A.

provenance.description: Flips to promoted_from_L4 only when §4.7's four gates all pass: >=10 verified outcome records, >=70%/<=30% signal split, >=3 rejected records, named human sign-off.

supporting_n.description: Counts VERIFIED outcome records only. Forum seed observations contribute zero — gate G16. This is what makes N10 ('never publish a success rate without a denominator') enforceable rather than aspirational.

refer_out_note.description: Present on refer_out codes. We do not draft these; the pattern exists so the free critique can explain WHY we route the case to counsel rather than silently refusing (the AppealDesk differentiator, §3.2).
